notes.title: Update - bug fixing
notes.content:
Hello, 

Another small patch to fix some issues found by the players and reported in the Steam discussions.

- Kudos. Players were experiencing a reset of Kudos when completing an account. Fixed, all new kudos (including those won in direct messages) are now correctly added with the old ones.
- Blue Lines FX. We allowed the possibility to switch from the minigames to the other part of the game even if you didn't finished it. In Medium & Hard difficulty, the blue FX separating the squares of the lewdoku didn't disappear. Fixed.
- Post/Week jinxed. It was possible, under certain circumstances to play 4 (or more) minigames in a row without changing weeks because the "new post" button didn't update faster that you already completed 3 posts. We added a security to be sure the button update faster that you can click.
This bug was causing issues in the feed/gallery ect... because the number of posts wasn't matching the number of weeks...
- Achievement Week 2. Another fix to make it works. Load an account after week 2 to unlock it directly. Please keep us updated.

- We changed some FX on some actions: buy upgrade, win puzzle, complete week...

This patch was supposed to be released earlier but due to very hard and big rains in my region it was delayed from Monday to today. Sorry about that.

notes.title: Update - Achievements week2 and more
notes.content:
Hello, 
Another small patch to fix few issues some of you encountered:
- Achievement week 2. Now working and we added a double check to complete it automatically if you have the week 3 completed. Open a session to unlock it.
- Achievement close account. We added a double check to be sure it's validate before the session close.
- Banner 12 & 13. They were duplicates of banner 11, they are now all new.
- Picture 31 (week 11) has been replaced by a better one!!
- Picture 35 (week 12) has also been replace by a brand new one :)
- Video downloads - We were a little bit too fast with the last update, the link to download was giving access to all the videos on our portal. It's now fixed and you only have access to the video you clicked.
Basically, we made a page per video.
- Typos - even more fixed thanks to your feedback. "programing" shame on me....
- Kudos issue - some players reported that they add thousands of kudos but can't buy anything. It was mainly because the number were rounded with 3 digits. Now, new kudos earned will be displayed with only one digit after the comma (2,1 instead of 2,074). If you have 2,074 kudos, it's 2,1 kudos.

We hope that those changes will help you enjoyed the game even more.
We are working on something huge, stay tuned.

Please continue to send us your feedback and bugs in the Steam Discussions: 
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1569590/discussions/
